summary: Formally deprecates several IPv4 options that fell out of use but were never officially retired, which tidies up the IANA registry. It also obsoletes RFC 1385, RFC 1393, RFC 1475 and RFC 1770 and asks that they be marked Historic.

eli5.summary: Cleaning out an old toolbox: some tools nobody has used for years are officially marked as retired, so nobody wonders whether they still matter.
